runtime_proof.significance: These suites are `{ skip: skipReason }`-gated on SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, so an absent credential yields a passing job with every test skipped. `skipped: 0` in both blocks, corroborated by 105s for seven test:db tests and 23.6s for three live submissions, is what establishes they actually executed against staging rather than short-circuiting. Test 3 is the case that failed at the previous binding with 'Missing expected rejection': its payload was byte-identical to test 1 except for distributionMode, and computeSubmissionIdempotencyKey (submission-service.ts:80-90) hashes source|market|selection|line|odds|eventName and not metadata, so it matched test 1's key and returned test 1's pick from the duplicate short-circuit at :150-195 -- which runs before the event gate at :203. The fixture now varies a run-scoped caseLabel through selection and eventName, neither of which waivesEventExistenceGate consults, leaving distributionMode as the only predicate input that differs.

runtime_proof.non_vacuity: The live suite was not mutation-tested; mutating it costs a full staging run. The ONLY difference is whether the submission carries a server-validated fallback outcome. Test 2 was refused and test 1 was accepted, which isolates the waiver as the cause of the acceptance. scope.detail: Seven files inside the pinned lock, plus this lane's own manifest, .ops/sync file and proof bundle. THREE files are outside it and are declared above rather than left to be discovered: adding a live-DB proof has two mandatory registration points, neither of which lives under apps/api/src, and admitting the second of those into the runtime lane's allowlist is the third. A file_scope_lock is pinned at lane-start and cannot be widened by an agent, so these need a CODEOWNERS scope-override/v1; the non-required 'File scope lock' check reporting them is a correct check reporting a real scope question, not a defective one. No workflow, no merge control, no branch protection, no containment setting, no deploy path and no migration is touched.

out_of_scope_files.package.json: Wires the new t1-proof suite into `test:t1-proof:live`. `pnpm verify` fails closed with WIRING_TEST_UNWIRED_NEW on any test file unreachable from a package script, and this is the only wiring point for a live-DB proof.
out_of_scope_files.docs/05_operations/db-writer-classificat: Registers the new suite as a credentialed DB test with owner `api` and its single executing command. `verify`'s 'Enforce DB writer classification' step fails closed without it.
out_of_scope_files..lane/lanes/runtime.yml: Admits docs/05_operations/db-writer-classification.json into the runtime lane's allowed_path_globs as one exact file. Without it `Lane authority` fails with `outside_allowed_paths` and no runtime lane can legally carry its own live-DB proof. Allowlist admission correction only -- no taxonomy change, no executor-policy change, no change to any required check.
